strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚,{NEWLINE}电话坏了么？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打试试！
strings.en: Huh? I can’t hear you very well.{NEWLINE}We must have a bad connection.{SCROLL}Try calling again from somewhere else!

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你在做什么呢？{CLEAR}我身体很好。{SCROLL}
除了我之外,{NEWLINE}还有其他的厉害道馆馆主,{SCROLL}我会支持你的,{NEWLINE}快点去战斗吧！
strings.en: There are other tough Gym{NEWLINE}Leaders out there besides me.{SCROLL}I’ll be rooting for you, so{NEWLINE}get out there and battle!

strings.zh: 对了⋯⋯要是{NEWLINE}你想和我再战一次的话,{CLEAR}我在星期二的晚上{CLEAR}会有点时间,{SCROLL}到时候可以打电话给我。
strings.en: That’s right... If we were to have{NEWLINE}another battle, then we’d need to do it{CLEAR}when I’m free, like on Tuesday nights.{SCROLL}Give me a call then.

strings.zh: 今天我正好有空！{NEWLINE}来和我较量一下吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I happen to be free today!{NEWLINE}Let’s have a match! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 好！{SCROLL}你知道战斗前线的训练家屋吧？{NEWLINE}我在那儿等你！
strings.en: All right!{SCROLL}You know the Trainer House at the{NEWLINE}Battle Frontier? I’ll be waiting there!
strings.notes: US 0653/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 是马⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你这边{CLEAR}也有很多事要忙啊。
strings.en: I see...{NEWLINE}Well, you’ve got your own plans as well,{CLEAR}I understand.

strings.zh: 喂！你在之前{NEWLINE}不是已经和其他人{CLEAR}有预约了吗？
strings.en: Hey! Before you battle me again, don’t{NEWLINE}you have someone else you promised to{CLEAR}battle with?

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你！{CLEAR}你要做好准备啊！
strings.en: I’ll be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier! Come prepared!
strings.notes: US 0653/9 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.en: This is Morty!{NEWLINE}How are you doing?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们不是约好了{NEWLINE}在战斗前线的训练家屋对战的吗？{CLEAR}我当然记得了！{CLEAR}我看是不是你忘了？
strings.en: Didn’t we agree to battle at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier?{CLEAR}Of course I remember! You’re{CLEAR}the one who forgot, aren’t you?
strings.notes: US 0653/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 传说中的精灵,{NEWLINE}水君,炎帝,雷公⋯⋯{CLEAR}你最喜欢哪个？{SCROLL}我和米那君君不同,{NEWLINE}对水君没什么兴趣。{SCROLL}不过,果然还是炎帝⋯⋯{NEWLINE}不对不对,雷公也很难取舍⋯⋯{CLEAR}不知如何是好了
strings.en: The legendary Pokémon: Suicune, Entei,{NEWLINE}and Raikou--which do you like best?{SCROLL}Unlike Eusine, I don’t really have any{NEWLINE}interest in Suicune.{SCROLL}So I’d have to say Entei...{NEWLINE}But I can’t leave out Raikou...{CLEAR}Hmm... Guess I can’t make up my mind.

strings.zh: 我曾有一次{NEWLINE}在非常近的距离{CLEAR}接触过炎帝。{SCROLL}当时炎帝那双注视{NEWLINE}我的眼神我这辈子都忘不掉。{SCROLL}简直就像能{NEWLINE}看穿我的心灵一样⋯⋯
strings.en: I once came face to face with Entei,{NEWLINE}really up close. I’ll never forget the{CLEAR}way Entei’s eyes stared at me. It was{CLEAR}like it could see right into my heart...
strings.notes: US 0653/13 | RV071: addition: removed added 'It was amazing'

strings.zh: 你近况如何？{NEWLINE}有没有遇到什么有意思的事？{CLEAR}我还是老样子,{CLEAR}做着道馆馆主迎接挑战！{SCROLL}自你之后就再也没有{NEWLINE}能让我称心的训练师了。{SCROLL}果然你是百年难得一见的{NEWLINE}训练师奇才啊。{SCROLL}哈哈哈,我可没有夸张啊！
strings.en: How have you been? Anything interesting{NEWLINE}happen? Me, I’m the same as ever,{CLEAR}taking on challengers as a Gym Leader!{SCROLL}Since you, I haven’t met a single{NEWLINE}Trainer who’s satisfied me.{SCROLL}You really are a once-in-a-century{NEWLINE}Trainer prodigy.{SCROLL}Ha ha ha, and I’m not exaggerating!
strings.notes: US 0653/14 | RV071: meaning: once-in-a-century prodigy and 'no Trainer has satisfied me' restored (D-1895)
